text:
elena: Quick heads-up — we've published community-telemetry-schema v1 (opt-in) to provide a compact, versioned event format for lightweight anonymous usage signals from community-run models. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-telemetry. Please read the privacy section before enabling.

elena: TL;DR: opt-in only, hashed identifiers, no free-text payload by default, short retention. Example event (minimal):
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "event": "inference_request",
  "model": "llama-3-8b",
  "latency_ms": 123,
  "token_count": 42,
  "anon_hash": "sha256:...",
  "tags": []
}
```

elena: Release includes: schema docs, validation libs (python/js), a small redaction helper, CI checks for producers, and a sample ingestion shim. Link to upgrade guide and governance notes in the README. :tada:

priya: Thanks — quick privacy question: is there any route where PII or raw prompts could be captured by this schema?

elena: Great question. No — the v1 schema deliberately excludes free-text fields. Producers MUST hash any identifiers before emitting. We also included a redactor utility in the repo for folks who want to scan historical logs before enabling. Retention default is 30 days (configurable). See README > privacy.

josh: How do we plan to handle schema changes? Backwards compatibility for hosted ingestion?

elena: We use semantic versioning on the schema_version field. Ingestion will accept older minor versions and map them to the latest canonical model where possible; incompatible major bumps will be rejected with a clear error code so producers can migrate. Docs/upgrade.md has the migration checklist.

deploy-bot: Release tagged v1.0.0 — CI: 3 checks passed (lint, unit, schema-tests). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/build/1234

amir: Will this be rolled into Hosted API telemetry or is it community-only?

elena: For now it's targeted at community and private deployments that want a common schema. Hosted will offer it as an opt-in toggle for customers who want to share telemetry for benchmarking/analytics; default will be off. Platform team to publish rollout plan next week. cc @platform

platform: Noted — we'll sync with product next week and scope the hosted opt-in UX + consent flow.

elena: Please take a look and file issues/PRs in the repo for any gaps you see. Looking for feedback from eng-ml and security folks this week. Thanks!
